description: User-facing branch metadata (name and visibility). The stable identity of a branch; the matching `lix_branch_ref` carries the moving head pointer. The catalog's `lix_branch` surface joins this descriptor with its ref to present a single user-visible branch row.

columns.name: hidden
columns.description: When true, the branch is filtered from default listings (CLI, catalog views); operations by explicit id still succeed.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Human-readable branch name (e.g. `main`, `feature-x`) shown in branch listings and CLI output.
